population.kidComparison: About 22.2 million people live in Malawi—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Warm tropical climate year-round with distinct wet and dry seasons.
geography.terrain: Inland terrain bordered by neighboring countries.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Malawi
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Malawi.

exploration.didYouKnow: Malawi is located in Eastern Africa and its capital city is Lilongwe.
